title: Price Is Right Losing Horn
blurb: Four descending notes, network-polished, and decades of televised disappointment behind them. The Price Is Right losing horn is the more expensive cousin of the sad trombone — same shape, better production values, considerably more public — and generations of daytime viewers have been trained to feel it in the chest before they have consciously processed the loss. Play it when a plan fails in front of witnesses, particularly one that was announced in advance. The definitive fanfare for losing gracefully while a studio audience watches.
origin: The losing horn from The Price Is Right game show.
